description: Source code for handling Git tree objects, including reading, parsing, comparing, and lookup functions.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Recursively reads a tree object, applying a callback function to each entry.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Initializes and calls read_tree_at to read a tree.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compares two base names with mode considerations.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compares two names, treating directory and file entries as equal.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Looks up or creates a tree object from an object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parses a tree object from a buffer.

methods.name: parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Reads and parses a tree object, with error handling for missing or invalid objects.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Parses a tree object indirectly from an object ID.
